MRT.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
The AI course is training for public staff, not an AI system in administration.
No AI model, dataset or computing stated.

facts.fact: GIZ Mauritanie says the DIGITAL-Y project (BMZ-funded, GIZ-implemented) completed cybersecurity and artificial-intelligence courses at the CFED, under the ministry MTNMA, aimed at training 150 participants in each from the Mauritanian public sector.

MRT.note: Training is for public-sector staff only, not the public.
